title: Phone rubric author attestation: explicit privacy-normalized evidence lineage
body:
Supersedes our original author attestation after its completed failed grading-integrity audit. Four passes are grounded in the complete87-row semantic census and inverse Decisions; two weak ratings explicitly preserve incomplete pairwise evidence and demonstrated check under-binding. This is rubric-quality evidence only; Phone remains unshipped. Retained independent critique WI-10004893 posts1153815/1153920 is preserved as review history, with canonical stores and saved source bytes used as the measuring instruments.

Publication-only evidence correction: the exact original snapshot bf403b0543de5697aea533664ce380af91cc4d91b48d25f5a41fc4df44219e2d is preserved in workspace-scoped artifacts:load {slug:'papercusp',rel_path:'evidence/phone-author-vetting/original-bf403b0543de5697aea533664ce380af91cc4d91b48d25f5a41fc4df44219e2d.json'} and its full 377762-byte round-trip was verified across 19 pages. The published snapshot at the legacy repository path is a distinct 377758-byte derivative, SHA-256 711c1d3baf7285214114fe09218f7a4caeedcf4ea0b318eafb810803f7553933. Only the personal name in one planDecisions owner tag was removed; the owner tier and session-turn provenance remain. Publication review SHA-256 592a85944477ce9c39ac9d79cdbc2b5feb802b80f6da64c911f8295c9b613ab6 names both identities and immutable original review/card/audit EI-24847745777507321 history. The 87 census judgments, nine inverse Decision rows, four embedded source hashes, four semantic pair checks, 3737 unreviewed-pair limit and all six rating values are unchanged. Its rerun passes and both publication files produce zero owner-tag/home-path/identity-literal hits. The prior PASS is retained as history for its original bytes; it is not relabeled as grading this derivative. This replacement requires its own routed independent grading-integrity audit. No criterion amendment or implementation/public PSTN acceptance is asserted.

outcomes-not-diff-restatements.evidence:
Exact evidence: docs/evidence/phone-author-vetting-publication-review-2026-10-02.json SHA-256 592a85944477ce9c39ac9d79cdbc2b5feb802b80f6da64c911f8295c9b613ab6; subject rubric4/hashf208eb77, method meta5/hash215de083, plan21/hash7477ae57. Re-run verbatim:
python3 - <<'PY'
import hashlib,json,pathlib,subprocess
p=pathlib.Path('docs/evidence/phone-author-vetting-publication-review-2026-10-02.json'); b=p.read_bytes()
assert hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest() == '592a85944477ce9c39ac9d79cdbc2b5feb802b80f6da64c911f8295c9b613ab6'
r=json.loads(b)
subprocess.run(r['rerun']['command'], shell=True, check=True)
PY
Read every census[].model and authorReview.concreteFailure (87 rows, R1..R87). Each grades an observed service state, behavior or guarantee: number/tenant binding, persistence, real phone audio, commercial limits, recovery, proof or rollout. A source diff alone observes none of the listed specific counterexamples. The command verifies the complete preserved model population and matching rows; semantic judgment is the explicit 87-row author review, not a regex/classifier. This rates contract form, not achieved implementation.

Each names a concrete failing observation: e.g. a foreign-tenant transcript after restart, two provider dial attempts on replay, a voicemail erased by restart, charges beyond hardcap, or missing external proof. Numerical/policy targets are evaluated against their approved retained contract when supplied; no target or policy is fabricated here. The command confirms one nonempty specific observation per exact immutable criterion; reviewer semantic comparison, not mere nonempty fields, is the pass evidence. No actual public outcome is graded healthy.

Downgrade corrects the original unsupported pass. Pairwise population87*86/2=3741; pairwiseReview explicitly records four semantic separating counterfactuals (R2/R13, R7/R84, R12/R74, R6/R75), each with one healthy and one broken contract outcome. Re-run the command to validate their exact criterion scope, then compare each observation with the two saved models. Remaining3737 pairs have not received a semantic separation review; lexical inequality does not certify them. This is an evidence-completeness downgrade, not a measured assertion that every unreviewed pair overlaps. Completing and recording those separations is the achievable next evidence action on this saved rubric.
